title: Canonical SCOBY D0/D1 Research Program: material identity, matrix engineering, reinforcement, electrostructuring, porosity, resource recovery, and evidence governance

audit_anchor_before_creation.purpose: Freeze the repository state against which this canonical audit was prepared.

provenance_policy: Historical branch artifacts remain provenance records unless explicitly marked stale or contradicted. This canonical record does not erase history; it resolves names, statuses, dependencies, claim ceilings, and missing-link repairs.

mission.scientific: Build a falsifiable, measurement-first understanding of SCOBY-derived bacterial-cellulose matrices and their transformations without promoting attractive hypotheses to facts.
mission.engineering: Identify reproducible, low-cost, benign material architectures with useful combinations of dry mechanics, wet retention, toughness, surface quality, manufacturability, and optional passive functionality.
mission.governance: Make every transition from idea to claim machine-readable, provenance-aware, resistant to confirmation bias, and explicit about missing evidence.
mission.resource: Evaluate whether SCOBY can function as a multi-output biological platform whose cellulose biomass and selected process streams can be valorized, while withholding zero-waste, economic, or environmental superiority claims until measured.

terminology_contract.SCOBY: Mixed fermentation system/pellicle context; not interchangeable with purified bacterial cellulose.
terminology_contract.BC: Bacterial cellulose; purification state and precursor history must be stated.
terminology_contract.pellicle: Hydrated sheet produced by the culture; not automatically a final material.
terminology_contract.chitin: N-acetylglucosamine-rich polymer. Source, purity, degree of acetylation and particle/fibril morphology matter.
terminology_contract.chitosan: Partially deacetylated chitin-derived polymer; not a synonym for chitin.
terminology_contract.incorporation: Evidence that an added phase is retained within the bulk matrix after appropriate washing/processing.
terminology_contract.reinforcement: A measured net structure-property improvement attributable to the added phase after confounds are controlled.
terminology_contract.simulation: Model-generated prediction object; never an observation and never experimental evidence.
terminology_contract.food_grade: Regulatory/specification status, not merely chemical identity or household cleanliness.

epistemic_model.critical_revision: Simulation/model status is not a rung between protocol and evidence. A simulation may coexist with E1 or E2 but cannot promote a branch to E3+.
epistemic_model.claim_rule: The public claim ceiling is always the lowest gate that has not been crossed, not the most exciting downstream possibility.

G0_REGISTRY_AND_PROVENANCE.pass_condition: Every result can be traced to a defined artifact, sample, process history, and raw record.

G1_PRECURSOR_IDENTITY.pass_condition: Starting material is sufficiently characterized to distinguish batch and composition effects.

G2_PROCESS_HISTORY.pass_condition: Nominal labels are replaced by measured or explicitly unresolved process variables.

G3_COMPOSITION_AND_INCORPORATION.pass_condition: Added phase is distinguished from surface contamination, sediment, residue, or process artifact.

G4_STRUCTURE.pass_condition: Structural mechanism is directly measured rather than inferred from appearance or bulk mechanics.

G5_FUNCTION.pass_condition: Claimed function survives appropriate controls and is reported with units and uncertainty.

G6_REPLICATION_AND_STATISTICS.pass_condition: Inference is made at the level of independent units and is not inflated by pseudoreplication.

G7_MANUFACTURABILITY_AND_RESOURCE_ACCOUN.pass_condition: A clever specimen is distinguished from a repeatable material process.

G8_BENCHMARK_AND_APPLICATION_VALIDATION.pass_condition: Material is validated for a named benign use rather than promoted from generic laboratory metrics.

G9_CLAIM.pass_condition: Claim text states evidence level, tested scope, uncertainty, and explicit non-generalization.

statistics_and_experimental_units.primary_rule: The independent experimental unit is the independently prepared pellicle/vessel/batch condition, not each strip cut from the same sheet.
statistics_and_experimental_units.pseudoreplication_example: Five tensile strips cut from one pellicle provide technical within-sheet sampling, not n=5 independent biological/material replicates.
statistics_and_experimental_units.confirmatory_policy: Power analysis or precision target should determine confirmatory replication; n=3 is not automatically sufficient.
statistics_and_experimental_units.blinding: Where feasible, blind mechanical testing, microscopy scoring, and image analysis to treatment identity.
statistics_and_experimental_units.randomization: Randomize vessel position, specimen cutting position, and measurement order or explicitly block them.

derived_metrics.wet_tensile_retention_percent: 100 * wet_strength / dry_strength using matched conditioning and explicit aggregation basis
derived_metrics.final_filler_volume_fraction: derive from measured retained mass fraction and traceable component densities with uncertainty

A_D0_PREPROCESSING_AND_THERMAL_IDENTITY.purpose: Keep thermal, microwave, solvent, drying and glycerol residue studies as blind material-identity problems rather than application-first synthesis claims.

audit_upgrade: Treat strips cut from one pellicle as technical subsamples.
Preserve independent-vessel replication as statistical n.
Screening thresholds produce CANDIDATE_FOR_STAGE2 only and do not define successful leather.

C_EXOGENOUS_CRUSTACEAN_CHITIN.core_question: Can a characterized crustacean-derived chitin phase be retained inside growing bacterial cellulose and create a net favorable composition-structure-property effect?
C_EXOGENOUS_CRUSTACEAN_CHITIN.anti_shortcut: No mechanical improvement may be attributed to chitin if retained loading, density, moisture, drying history, or bulk distribution are unresolved.

separation_rule.engineered_biomass: Authenticated research strain under approved containment; chitin fraction and cellulolytic damage measured.
separation_rule.household_contamination: UNKNOWN_FILAMENTOUS_FUNGUS until identified; observational/failure-analysis specimen only, not standardized inoculum.

D_FUNGAL_CHITIN_AND_CONTAMINATION.preferred_comparator: Direct characterized chitin incorporation provides a non-living comparator for apparent fungal reinforcement.

E_CHITIN_VS_BASALT_BENCHMARK.critical_revision: Compare at matched retained final filler volume fraction in the conditioned composite, not merely matched feed concentration or nominal mass fraction.

F_ELECTROSTRUCTURING_AND_ELECTROCHEMICAL.orientation_claim_rule: Mechanical anisotropy is a functional consequence candidate, not direct proof of fibril orientation. Orientation must be independently measured.
F_ELECTROSTRUCTURING_AND_ELECTROCHEMICAL.simulation_firewall: Frozen positive simulation remains a prediction object and must not be retrofitted after real data.

G_EXTERNAL_GAS_CONDITIONING.purpose: Separate gas-transfer and redox effects from direct electrode and field effects.
G_EXTERNAL_GAS_CONDITIONING.safety: Hydrogen-containing experiments require appropriate laboratory gas engineering. Mixed H2/O2 shortcut experiments are not authorized.

critical_separation.freeze_thaw: Repeated freezing and thawing of wet matrix.
critical_separation.freeze_drying: Sublimation drying of a frozen matrix under reduced pressure.
critical_separation.ice_templating: Directional or controlled freezing used to template pore architecture.
critical_separation.solvent_assisted_freeze_drying: Separate process involving solvent history and freeze-drying; evidence cannot be transferred to simple freezer cycling.

H_CRYOPROCESSING_AND_POROSITY_ENGINEERIN.mechanical_rule: Porosity engineering may trade strength for transport or sorption; do not assume reinforcement.

I_MULTIFUNCTIONAL_BENIGN_SKIN.priority: Mechanical, wet and manufacturing baseline precedes optional passive functionality.
I_MULTIFUNCTIONAL_BENIGN_SKIN.ballistic_boundary: Ballistic or weapon-protection predictions are outside D1 claim scope. Puncture and tear remain generic material metrics only.

J_RESOURCE_RECOVERY_ACETATE_AND_FOOD_BOU.technical_goal: Quantify acetate generation and recovery as a chemical co-product with identity, mass balance, purity, yield, and manufacturability gates.
J_RESOURCE_RECOVERY_ACETATE_AND_FOOD_BOU.food_rule: Technical acetate must not be represented as E262 or food-grade based on chemical similarity alone.
J_RESOURCE_RECOVERY_ACETATE_AND_FOOD_BOU.resource_claim_rule: Acetate recovery may improve resource utilization, but zero-waste, LCA, and economic superiority remain unverified until measured.

negative_result_policy.rule: Negative, null, and contradictory results are first-class outputs and must not be deleted, averaged away, or reclassified as failed execution without evidence.

stale_or_dangling_references.resolution: Create a revised protocol before real experimentation; simulation remains frozen.
Create only when a safe gas-conditioning protocol is ready.
Replace broad label with explicit freeze-thaw, freeze-drying and ice-templating separation.
Recreate technical acetate protocol with identity-specific assay and mass-balance gates.

registry_audit.master_resolution: This v2.0 record is the canonical navigation and governance layer. Historical files remain provenance and should not be deleted merely because they are superseded as indexes.

priority_roadmap.P0: Execute Stage1 GEN0-GEN3 and establish real independent-unit baseline data.
priority_roadmap.P1A: Freeze crustacean-chitin material identity and run matched incorporation screen; no reinforcement label before bulk incorporation and net effect.
priority_roadmap.P1B: Create repaired electrosynthesis protocol separating electrode/current/pH/DO/ORP effects from any orientation mechanism.
priority_roadmap.P2: Compare chitin and basalt at matched retained final volume fraction after chitin compatibility is demonstrated.
priority_roadmap.P3: Register distinct freeze-thaw, freeze-drying and ice-templating branches.
priority_roadmap.P4: Fungal-chitin and hydrogen/gas-conditioning work only under appropriate laboratory containment and engineering.
priority_roadmap.parallel_repair: Recreate technical acetate production record while keeping E262 as a separate regulatory boundary.

claim_ceiling_matrix.D0_residue: PROVISIONAL_MATERIAL_IDENTITY_ONLY until characterization and application-specific validation
claim_ceiling_matrix.chitin_incorporation: INCORPORATED_CHITIN_COMPOSITE only after G3; REINFORCED only after G5 and G6
claim_ceiling_matrix.fungal_chitin: CONTROLLED_BIOMASS_COMPOSITE_CANDIDATE only under identity and inactivation gates
claim_ceiling_matrix.chitin_vs_basalt: PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_COMPARISON only at matched retained Vf
claim_ceiling_matrix.electrosynthesis: ELECTROCHEMICALLY_MODIFIED_GROWTH_CANDIDATE; ORIENTED only after direct orientation evidence
claim_ceiling_matrix.technical_acetate: TECHNICAL_ACETATE_CANDIDATE until identity and purity gates
claim_ceiling_matrix.E262: NO_FOOD_GRADE_CLAIM without applicable official specification and regulatory compliance
claim_ceiling_matrix.passive_EMC: LABORATORY_PASSIVE_EMC_PROPERTY only after calibrated fixture measurement

literature_evidence_ledger.citation: Mechanical and structural property analysis of bacterial cellulose composites
literature_evidence_ledger.supports: Additives present during BC biosynthesis can alter morphology and mechanical properties.
literature_evidence_ledger.does_not_prove: Shrimp-chitin powder will be uniformly incorporated or reinforcing in SCOBY.

literature_evidence_ledger.citation: Development of antibacterial nanocomposites by combination of bacterial cellulose/chitin nanofibrils
literature_evidence_ledger.supports: BC/chitin-nanofibril composite membranes are a real materials class.
literature_evidence_ledger.does_not_prove: Current shell-waste feed route, loading, or fermentation compatibility.

literature_evidence_ledger.citation: Regenerated chitin fibers reinforced with bacterial cellulose nanocrystals
literature_evidence_ledger.supports: Chitin/cellulose interfaces can be engineered for composite mechanics.
literature_evidence_ledger.does_not_prove: Bulk SCOBY reinforcement from heterogeneous shell-derived chitin.

literature_evidence_ledger.citation: Metabolic Investigation in Gluconacetobacter xylinus and Its Bacterial Cellulose Production under a Direct Current Electric Field
literature_evidence_ledger.supports: A DC electrochemical environment can change metabolism and BC production in a studied system.
literature_evidence_ledger.does_not_prove: Direct fibril alignment in the current SCOBY geometry.

literature_evidence_ledger.citation: Growing bacterial cellulose under AC electric fields
literature_evidence_ledger.supports: AC electric-field and dielectrophoretic conditions can alter cell positioning and BC growth in a studied system.
literature_evidence_ledger.does_not_prove: Frozen DC simulation or its mechanical values.

literature_evidence_ledger.citation: Ethanol-mediated freeze-drying enables robust bacterial cellulose aerogels
literature_evidence_ledger.supports: Solvent history and freeze-drying can strongly affect BC aerogel structure.
literature_evidence_ledger.does_not_prove: Simple freeze-thaw cycling creates the same structure.

literature_evidence_ledger.citation: Different temperatures select distinctive acetic acid bacteria species and promotes organic acids production during Kombucha tea fermentation
literature_evidence_ledger.supports: Kombucha microbial composition and acid production depend on process conditions.
literature_evidence_ledger.does_not_prove: A universal SCOBY composition or universal acetate yield.

authority_rule: This v2.0 artifact is the canonical index and epistemic governance layer for the SCOBY D0/D1 program as audited on 2026-08-14. It does not retroactively make any historical hypothesis true, does not convert simulations into evidence, and does not erase historical provenance. Branch-level raw data and protocol artifacts remain authoritative for their own measured content.
